Description
Position and Perks

Show off your culinary skills in the kitchen and bring us your talent. Do you have a passion for great food and an eye for presentation?

A Dream Career Awaits

We prioritize the health and well-being of our team members. Competitive compensation and benefits are offered to associates, based on eligibility and availability.

Benefits and Advantages:

Competitive Pay: $16.50 - $23.50 per hour based on experience
Health Care Benefits
Flexible Hours
Extensive Training
Meal Discounts
Real Advancement Opportunities
Duties and Responsibilities

The line cook position requires consistent excellence in food preparation, adherence to safety protocols, cleanliness standards, equipment setup, and stock verification.

Prepares menu items according to recipes, plate presentations, and specifications.
Completes all assigned prep work.
Sets up work station according to station diagram.
Practices sanitary and safe food handling at all times.
Cleans and sanitizes the work area before, during, and after shift.
Completes assigned daily and weekly cleaning projects.
Requirements and Qualifications

To be qualified, line cooks must have excellent communication skills, mobility throughout the shift, the ability to lift 25-50 lbs, and stand for extended periods.

The minimum age requirement for this position is 18 years old.
